movieinfo.synopsis:
THE ODYSSEY - SHOT ENTIRELY WITH IMAX FILM CAMERA! 

The greatest journey home begins on the biggest screen.

From visionary filmmaker Christopher Nolan comes The Odyssey, a mythic action epic based on one of the most legendary stories ever told.

Inspired by Homer’s ancient Greek epic poem, The Odyssey follows Odysseus, the King of Ithaca, as he fights to return home after the Trojan War. What should be a journey back to his family becomes a dangerous voyage across seas, monsters, gods, temptation and fate.

 

tldr: After the Trojan War, Odysseus faces a dangerous voyage back to Ithaca, meeting creatures like the Cyclops Polyphemus, Sirens, and Circe along the way.

 

Starring Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Zendaya, Robert Pattinson, Lupita Nyong’o and Charlize Theron, The Odyssey brings together a massive ensemble cast for a cinematic adventure about courage, survival, love, loyalty and the price of finding your way home.

Shot as a grand big-screen experience, The Odyssey is made for audiences who want more than just a movie. This is a journey through myth, war and destiny — told with the scale, intensity and visual ambition of a Christopher Nolan film.

Book your The Odyssey movie tickets at TGV Cinemas and experience the epic journey on the big screen.

movieinfo.staticContent:
Experience The Odyssey in IMAX at TGV

Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey is not just filmed for the cinema. It is filmed for IMAX.

The Odyssey marks a major moment for large-format filmmaking. Nolan and his team used IMAX technology to bring audiences closer to the world of Odysseus, capturing the scale of ancient seas, war, myth and human struggle with maximum visual impact.

At TGV Cinemas, IMAX gives audiences a bigger, sharper and more immersive way to experience blockbuster movies. With IMAX with Laser and 12-Channel Sound Technology available at selected TGV locations, moviegoers can experience brighter images, deeper contrast, powerful sound and a screen built for true cinematic scale.

For a Christopher Nolan film like The Odyssey, IMAX is not just an upgrade. It is the way the journey was meant to be felt.

Choose IMAX at TGV and step into the legend.  Read what others projects of Nolan's The Odyssey

 

From One of the Greatest Stories Ever Told

Before it became a movie, The Odyssey was one of the most important epic poems in world literature.

Attributed to the ancient Greek poet Homer, The Odyssey tells the story of Odysseus and his long journey home after the Trojan War. Along the way, he faces mythical creatures, impossible trials, powerful gods and the pain of being separated from the people he loves.

For centuries, the story has inspired books, plays, films, games, art and countless modern adventures. Its themes are still powerful today: the need to return home, the cost of war, the test of loyalty and the question of what makes a hero truly worthy.

Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey brings this timeless story to a new generation with the scale of a modern theatrical event.

 

A Christopher Nolan Cinematic Event

The Odyssey is not just another adventure film. It is the next major theatrical event from Christopher Nolan, the filmmaker behind some of modern cinema’s biggest and most talked-about big-screen experiences.

Known for films that reward audiences in cinemas, Nolan brings his signature scale, practical intensity and immersive storytelling to one of mythology’s greatest journeys.

With Matt Damon as Odysseus and a star-studded cast including Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Zendaya, Robert Pattinson, Lupita Nyong’o and Charlize Theron, The Odyssey is one of the must-watch cinema releases for fans of epic adventure, mythology and large-format storytelling.

 

 What Is The Odyssey About?

After the Trojan War, Odysseus begins the long journey back to Ithaca, where his wife Penelope and son Telemachus await his return.

But the way home is filled with danger. Odysseus must face storms, enemies, monsters, temptation and the will of the gods as he struggles to survive and reunite with his family.

At its heart, The Odyssey is not only about adventure. It is about a man trying to return to the life he lost, while the world tests whether he still deserves it.

 

The Confirmed Cast of Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey and Their Roles

Nolan's upcoming project is bringing Homer's legendary epic poem to the big screen with an all-star Hollywood ensemble. Ever since the trailer dropped, there are a lot of speculations of the roles. So far, here are the confirmed ones:

Also, we've covered the potential Gods and Goddesses That Might Appear in The Odyssey.

 

Matt Damon as Odysseus

Matt Damon stars as the King of Ithaca, whose decision to blind the Cyclops Polyphemus earns the wrath of Poseidon and transforms a simple voyage into a decade-long struggle for survival. The film marks Damon's third collaboration with Christopher Nolan.

 

Tom Holland as Telemachus

Tom Holland plays Odysseus' son, Telemachus, who matures from a young boy into a determined hero while protecting his mother and searching for his missing father.

 

Anne Hathaway as Penelope

Anne Hathaway portrays Penelope, Odysseus' loyal wife, who patiently waits for her husband's return while defending her kingdom against relentless suitors.

 

Robert Pattinson as Antinous

Robert Pattinson plays Antinous, one of Penelope's most dangerous suitors, who schemes to seize control of Ithaca and eliminate Telemachus.

 

Zendaya as Athena

Zendaya takes on the role of Athena, the goddess of wisdom who guides Odysseus throughout his journey and encourages Telemachus to search for his father.

 

Charlize Theron as Calypso

Charlize Theron portrays the immortal nymph Calypso, who keeps Odysseus on her island for seven years while offering him eternal life if he chooses to stay.

 

Mia Goth as Circe

Mia Goth plays Circe, the powerful enchantress who transforms Odysseus' crew into pigs before eventually becoming one of his allies.

 

Abraham Popoola as Polyphemus

Abraham Popoola appears as the fearsome Cyclops Polyphemus, whose blinding at the hands of Odysseus sets the hero's tragic journey in motion.

 

Lupita Nyong'o as Helen of Troy

Lupita Nyong'o portrays Helen of Troy, whose abduction sparked the Trojan War. Reports also suggest she plays Helen's sister, Clytemnestra.

 

Jon Bernthal as Menelaus

Jon Bernthal stars as the King of Sparta and husband of Helen, who meets Telemachus during his search for Odysseus.

 

Benny Safdie as Agamemnon

Benny Safdie portrays Agamemnon, the King of Mycenae and commander of the Greek forces during the Trojan War.

 

Michael Cera as Eumaeus

Michael Cera plays Eumaeus, the loyal swineherd who faithfully protects Odysseus' household throughout his master's long absence.

 

Joseph Quinn as Melantho

Joseph Quinn portrays Melantho, a maid raised by Penelope who ultimately betrays the royal household by siding with the suitors.

 

Why Watch The Odyssey at TGV?

The Odyssey is the kind of film built for the cinema — and especially for IMAX.

This is a massive mythic adventure with sea voyages, war, monsters, gods, emotional stakes and a star-studded cast. From the world of ancient Greece to the dangerous journey home, every moment is designed to feel bigger, louder and more immersive on the big screen.

Watch it at TGV Cinemas for the full theatrical experience: the scale, the sound, the tension and the feeling of travelling with Odysseus through one of the greatest journeys ever told.

Bring your friends. Choose your seats. Face your fate.

movieinfo.staticContent:
The Minions Have a Monstrous Problem!

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

Minions & Monsters is directed by Academy Award® nominee Pierre Coffin, a director of the first three Despicable Me films and the first Minions film. Coffin has also provided the voice for the Minions since their film debut in 2010. The film is written by Brian Lynch (Minions, The Secret Life of Pets films) and Pierre Coffin and produced by Illumination’s Academy Award® nominated founder and CEO Chris Meledandri and by Bill Ryan (executive producer, The Super Mario Bros. Movie). The executive producer is Brian Lynch.

More than ten years after their creation, the Minions have become the most iconic animated characters of their generation. Globally recognized and beloved by fans of all ages, they have propelled Illumination’s Despicable Me and Minions to a global box office of more than $5.6 billion.

movieinfo.synopsis:
FOLLOWING THE SUCCESS OF EVIL DEAD RISE WITH OVER USD 145 MIL BOX OFFICE COLLECTION: The family reunion from hell begins AGAIN at TGV Cinemas.
 

From the terrifying world of Evil Dead comes a new supernatural horror nightmare where grief, family secrets and demonic possession collide. Directed by Sébastien Vaniček, Evil Dead Burn brings the Deadites back to the big screen with a brutal new story set inside a remote family home where comfort slowly turns into chaos.

After losing her husband, a woman seeks peace with her in-laws at their secluded home. But what begins as a painful attempt to heal soon becomes something far more horrifying. One by one, members of the family are transformed into Deadites, turning the house into a violent nightmare with no easy way out.

As the evil spreads, she is forced to confront the promises she made in life, the horror waiting in death, and the terrifying question of whether family can still be trusted when something inhuman is wearing their faces.

Starring Souheila Yacoub, Hunter Doohan, Luciane Buchanan and Tandi Wright, Evil Dead Burn is made for horror fans who want a tense, bloody and relentless cinema experience.

Book your Evil Dead Burn movie tickets at TGV Cinemas and experience the next chapter of the Evil Dead universe on the big screen.
movieinfo.staticContent:
From the Franchise That Refuses to Die

The Evil Dead franchise is one of horror’s most recognisable cult legacies. What began as a low-budget cabin-in-the-woods nightmare grew into a long-running horror universe filled with Deadites, demonic possession, extreme survival, dark humour and unforgettable blood-soaked chaos.

Across the years, Evil Dead has evolved from the original classic trilogy to darker modern entries like Evil Dead and Evil Dead Rise, proving that the franchise can keep reinventing itself for a new generation of horror fans.

The last big-screen entry, Evil Dead Rise, became a major success worldwide, earning more than US$147 million globally and becoming the highest-grossing Evil Dead film to date. Now, Evil Dead Burn continues that legacy with a fresh standalone nightmare built for the cinema.

 

 

Is Evil Dead Burn Based on a Book?

Evil Dead Burn is not based on a real novel or book. Instead, the Evil Dead franchise is famously connected to an in-universe cursed text known as the Book of the Dead, also called the Necronomicon Ex-Mortis.

In Evil Dead lore, this terrifying book contains ancient incantations that can awaken demonic forces and unleash the Deadites. It is one of the most iconic objects in horror cinema and a major reason why Evil Dead remains so memorable among genre fans.

So while Evil Dead Burn is not a traditional book adaptation, it continues the franchise’s connection to cursed writings, demonic possession and the horrifying consequences of opening doors that should have stayed closed.

 

 

Why Watch Evil Dead Burn at TGV?

Evil Dead Burn is not the kind of horror you watch quietly at home. This is a full cinema scream-session built for fans of supernatural horror, survival terror and intense big-screen scares.

Expect a claustrophobic setting, terrifying Deadite transformations, brutal family horror, and the kind of shocking moments that make Evil Dead one of horror’s most iconic franchises.

Bring your bravest friends. Pick your seats. Do not watch this alone.

 

 

About Evil Dead Burn

Evil Dead Burn continues the legacy of the Evil Dead franchise with a new standalone horror story. Instead of simply repeating the past, this chapter introduces a fresh nightmare built around grief, family, possession and survival.

The film is directed by Sébastien Vaniček, known for intense horror filmmaking, and features a cast led by Souheila Yacoub, Hunter Doohan, Luciane Buchanan and Tandi Wright.

For fans of Evil Dead, Evil Dead Rise, demonic possession films, survival horror and violent supernatural thrillers, this is one of the must-watch horror releases of 2026.

 

 

Is Evil Dead Burn connected to Evil Dead Rise?

Evil Dead Burn is part of the same Evil Dead horror franchise, but it tells a new standalone story. You do not need to watch every previous Evil Dead movie to understand it, but fans of Evil Dead Rise will recognise the franchise’s signature Deadite horror.

YOU WILL LOVE THIS MOVIE SO SO SO SO SOOO MUCH! Bear made a wish for a "LOVELY" girlfriend ... and regretted.
 
 
---
Bear, a shy music store employee, has secretly loved his best friend Nikki for years. When he stumbles upon a novelty toy called the "One Wish Willow," he uses it to wish for Nikki to love him back.

The wish works — but with horrifying consequences. Nikki transforms into a dangerously obsessive version of herself, devoted to Bear yet violently unhinged, while the real Nikki remains trapped inside, desperate to be freed.

As the situation spirals into chaos and deadly violence, Bear is forced to face the devastating truth: you can't force someone to love you without destroying who they are.
